Shop My Account Donations Your charitable contributions help defray the cost of new year-round productions, our 16 summer performances in Pinkney Park, Rowayton, as well as our year-round education programs.
Our ticket prices do not cover the total expense of our productions.
Each year we must raise at least $115,000 from supporters like you to maintain our low ticket prices.
In order to provide educational programming to those who do not have access to Shakespeare or theatre education, we rely on your generosity.
Please help us to continue our mission of providing affordable, professional Shakespeare productions to our community.
Your tax-deductible gift of any amount will be most appreciated.
DONATE Shakespeare on the Sound i s a proud member of the Shakespeare Theatre Association Where Shakespeare Lives Now!
